annotation.authors_or_issuer: Doménech, S.; Infiesta, N.; Infiesta, J.L.; Seuba, J.C.
key_provisions_or_claims: Older people must be informed and able to decide their relationship with the robot.
Robots must not replace human attention, warmth or affect from professionals.
Vulnerable residents should not develop emotional attachment to the robot.
Ethical reflection should accompany field work on robots such as Pepper.
Interdisciplinary collaboration among technology, health and law is needed.
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Short opinion article reflecting on ethical aspects of introducing social robots (Pepper running the Helderly app) into Catalan nursing homes. It stresses informed choice for residents, avoiding emotional attachment and replacement of human care, and calls for interdisciplinary field work paired with ethical reflection.
annotation.title_clean: Social Robots in Nursing Homes: Field Work and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Social Robots in Nursing Homes: Field Work and Ethics
annotation.venue: Open Access Journal of Gerontology & Geriatric Medicine
